intro.title: File uploads
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build a simple Express server that accepts file uploads from a user. You'll learn how to handle multipart/form-data using the multer middleware to process uploaded files. The core concepts include configuring middleware, managing file storage, and accessing uploaded file details in your routes. By the end, you'll have a working endpoint that can receive and save files to your server's filesystem.
intro.usecase: File uploads are essential in countless real-world applications where users need to submit documents, images, or media. You'll implement this pattern in user profile forms for avatar pictures, in content management dashboards for uploading articles with images, and in e-commerce platforms for product photo galleries. As a developer, you'll handle uploads in customer support systems for attaching screenshots, in document-sharing applications like Google Drive alternatives, and in social media platforms where users post photos and videos. Understanding Express file uploads prepares you to build these common features that require secure, efficient handling of user-generated files.
